title: Senior Manager Operations Maintenance
text:
**Position Summary:**

The Manager, Operations Maintenance (Production) is responsible for overseeing and coordinating production personnel activities and ensuring accurate and timely completion of associated documentation in support ofensuring the operation and maintenance of production (prep, compounding, and filling) machinery and mechanical equipment in compliance with all safety policies, cGMPs, and SOPs. This role works cross-functionally with quality, engineering, manufacturing, technical transfer, and validation. The Manager, Operations Maintenance (Production) will rely on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals, which include organizing hourly employees in the performance of their duties, driving productivity to achieve optimum results, coordinating labor needs in support of minimizing active batch downtime and preventative maintenance schedule attainment. Additionally, the Operations Maintenance Manager (Production) oversees special project for process improvements to the manufacturing process. This position supports the ongoing development, manufacture, and distribution of pharmaceutical products in compliance with local procedures, corporate policies, and the regulatory requirements of the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Maintain a sterile environment in the clean room by complying with garbing and behavior requirements that align to established cGMP practices and techniques
* Enforce/follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), safety policies, batch records, current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP), including Data Integrity and Good Documentation Practices (GDocP)
* Manage the operations maintenance (production) team to perform responsibilities associated with the troubleshooting/repair/preventative maintenance of GMP utilities and GMP pharmaceutical processing equipment, as well as accurate and timely completion of associated documentation
* Ensure operations maintenance (production) team members adequately support the production operations teams (Prep, Compounding and Fill) with equipment changeovers, set-ups, and start-up activities
* Ensure accurate and complete spare parts inventories are maintained
* Plan and execute operations maintenance (production) shut down/start up activities
* Conduct employee reviews and provide coaching as appropriate; maintain performance and attendance records
* Improve existing processes and/or equipment functionality in order to improve operational efficiency
* Assist with deviation investigations, CAPAs, Change Controls, and other documents as needed
* Manage the maintenance operations (production) team to execute support requests from manufacturing, technical transfer, validation, and engineering
* Ensure self and direct reports are trained and work in compliance with applicable SOPs, cGMPs, regulatory requirements, safety, environmental, mechanical/electrical maintenance/troubleshooting principles, and company policies
* Perform other duties as assigned

**Required Skills:**

* Ability to comply with and enforce aseptic practices and cleanroom behavior
* Ability to lead a maintenance team to efficiently and accurately execute repairs/preventative maintenance activities designed to minimize active batch downtime
* Ability to hold employees accountable for accurate, complete and timely task execution
* Must display sound judgment, ability to seek guidance, and provide clear directions
* Strong analytical, listening, verbal/written communication, achieve accuracy without being rushed, efficient time-management, problem-solving, attention to detail, prioritization, organization, interpersonal, computer and conflict management skills
* Ability to read and understand wiring diagrams and P&ID and possess a basic understanding of mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems
* Knowledge of lock out tag out procedures
* Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs without assistance

**Education and Experience Requirements:**

* BS degree in Engineering (or related field) preferred. An appropriate mix of education and experience in a cGMP manufacturing environment may be considered in lieu of a formal degree.
* 7+ years industrial maintenance experience (preferably in an aseptic pharmaceutical manufacturing environment) and minimally 3-5 years of leadership experience preferred
* Experience with (or knowledge of) programmable logic controllers and/or Distributed Control Systems is preferred
* Familiarity with pharmaceutical manufacturing systems including PMS (particle measuring systems) and air monitoring systems, high purity water systems (WFI), HVAC equipment and systems, compressors, air/gas supply and distribution, plant and clean steam generation and distribution, refrigeration equipment, vacuum systems, and waste collection/drainage systems, as well as pharmaceutical manufacturing equipment (filling machines, washers, loaders, depyrogenation ovens, autoclaves, lyophilizer, etc) is also preferred
* Experience with maintenance and operation of manufacturing equipment in an active aseptic or terminally sterilized manufacturing environment preferred
* Experience with computerized Maintenance Management Systems like Blue Mountain or equivalent preferred
